_comment: Your existing portfolio photos — the ones already on the website that did not come
through the forms. Drop the image files into seed/images/ and list them here.
Each item has a 'before' list and an 'after' list. They do NOT have to be the same
length, and photo 1 of one list is not treated as the partner of photo 1 in the other —
the gallery shows them as two labelled groups. Either list may be empty.
Filenames are case-sensitive. Delete the examples once you have added your own.
